text:
Emily: quick QA pass found ~7 pages in /docs/deploy with images 404 and a stray duplicate `meta:` frontmatter on a couple files. I can open a small PR to fix paths and drop the extra frontmatter. Anyone owning these pages right now? /cc @michael @raj

Raj: likely some belong to platform-docs, others might be orphaned. If you can drop the file list I can help assign owners.

Emily: files I hit locally: deploy/onprem/install.md, deploy/vpc/networking.md, deploy/dedicated/faq.md, runtime/kv-cache.md, runtime/batching.md, ops/rollback.md, onboarding/setup.md

Michael: if they're mostly in deploy/ I can take `deploy/*`. Tag me on the PR and I'll do the review pass. @laura fyi for customer-facing wording.

Laura: quick Q — are any of these localized? If we change headings/alt text we need to ensure i18n gets a sweep. I can run the workflow after merge.

Emily: plan is minimal edits: fix broken image URLs, remove the extra `meta:` line, and tweak alt text where missing. sed/perl commands I'm using locally: 
```
# remove stray meta: lines and normalize relative image paths
sed -i '' '/^meta:/d' **/*.md
perl -pi -e "s@\(\.\./images/@(/images/@g" **/*.md
```

Emily: opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 (WIP) — pinging reviewers @michael @raj

DocsBot: link-checker: 4 image 404s detected in PR 5123: deploy/onprem/install.md (img-2.png), deploy/vpc/networking.md (network-diagram.svg), runtime/batching.md (batching.gif), onboarding/setup.md (screenshot.png)

Raj: I'll try to claim runtime/* once the PR updates land. @emily can you add a short changelog note for visibility so QA knows the scope?

Emily: added a "docs: small image/path fixes + remove stray frontmatter" line in the PR description and left inline comments where I changed alt text.

Michael: looks good from my side. Please add me to the approvals list and go ahead once Raj signs off on runtime files.

Laura: when merged I'll trigger the i18n sweep and let localization know if strings changed. If any translated files break we'll open follow-ups.

Emily: merging after 1 more approval. thanks all :thumbsup:

Raj: thanks — I'll follow up on owner assignment for the runtime pages and file a small ticket to track translation updates if needed. :memo:
